questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Disposal of obsolete computers, electronic hardware, and used batteries must be executed exclusively through authorized dismantlers and recyclers.
Reason (R): Electronic waste contains toxic and hazardous substances, and its disposal is strictly governed by statutory E-Waste (Management) Rules acknowledged under GFR provisions.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english: Under GFR 2017 Rule 218 and MoEFCC guidelines, electronic items (computers, printers, monitors) and chemical batteries cannot be sold as ordinary scrap to unauthorized local ragpickers or scrap dealers. Electronic waste contains hazardous elements like lead, mercury, cadmium, and brominated flame retardants. Therefore, the statutory E-Waste (Management) Rules and Battery Waste Management Rules legally obligate all government departments and institutions to dispose of e-waste only through Central/State Pollution Control Board (CPCB/SPCB) registered and authorized dismantlers or recyclers. Thus, Assertion (A) is true, Reason (R) is true, and (R) correctly explains why such disposal is strictly restricted.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218 तथा पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, अनुपयोगी कंप्यूटर, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण और बैटरियों को सामान्य कबाड़ की तरह खुले बाजार में नहीं बेचा जा सकता। ई-कचरे में सीसा (lead), पारा (mercury) और कैडमियम जैसे खतरनाक और विषाक्त भारी धातु होते हैं जो पर्यावरण और मानव स्वास्थ्य को गंभीर नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं। अतः वैधानिक 'ई-अपशिष्ट (प्रबंधन) नियम' यह अनिवार्य करते हैं कि सरकारी कार्यालय केवल केंद्रीय/राज्य प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB/SPCB) से पंजीकृत एवं अधिकृत रीसाइक्लर्स या डिस्मेंटलर्स को ही ई-कचरा सौंपें। इस प्रकार अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Obsolete electronic equipment, computer hardware, and used batteries contain hazardous substances requiring environmentally safe handling. Financial guidelines mandate that e-waste disposal comply strictly with statutory E-Waste Management Rules. Consequently, public establishments must sell or transfer condemned electronic items exclusively to registered recyclers or authorized dismantlers holding valid environmental agency certifications.

questions.question_english: According to the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, the term "Public Money" does NOT include which of the following?
options_english: Revenues realized by the Government through direct and indirect taxes.
Loans raised by the Government through treasury bills and market borrowings.
Private donations or gifts received by an employee in an individual personal capacity.
Moneys credited into the Public Account of India, including provident funds and small savings.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017, 'Public Money' or 'Public Funds' means the Consolidated Fund of India, the Contingency Fund of India, and the Public Account of India, comprising all revenues, market borrowings, loan recoveries, statutory deposits, and remittances. Moneys received or held by a government servant in a strictly private or individual personal capacity are not public funds. Acceptance of personal gifts is governed by CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, but such amounts do not form part of Government accounts or Public Money.
questions.explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 के अनुसार, 'सार्वजनिक धन' (Public Money) का अर्थ भारत की संचित निधि (Consolidated Fund of India), भारत की आकस्मिकता निधि (Contingency Fund of India) और भारत के लोक खाते (Public Account of India) में आने वाले समस्त राजस्व, ऋण, बाजार उधारी, भविष्य निधि जमा और प्रेषणों से है। किसी कर्मचारी द्वारा अपनी व्यक्तिगत हैसियत से प्राप्त निजी दान या राशि सार्वजनिक धन का हिस्सा नहीं होती है (यद्यपि ऐसा उपहार स्वीकार करना आचरण नियमों द्वारा विनियमित होता है)। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Private donations received by an employee in personal capacity.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: in personal capacity. Public money encompasses all official revenues, tax collections, market borrowings, loans, and statutory deposits credited to the Consolidated Fund of India or the Public Account of India. Personal monetary gifts or private donations accepted by a government employee in an individual capacity are entirely outside the statutory domain of public money, although receiving personal gifts remains subject to separate conduct rules.

questions.question_english: Under Rule 217 of GFR 2017, when an item becomes unserviceable due to normal wear and tear or technical obsolescence, what is the formal administrative process of declaring it unfit for use called?
options_english: Depreciation
Condemnation
Sequestration
Write-off
questions.explanation_english: Under Chapter 7 (Disposal of Goods), Rule 217 of GFR 2017, an item may be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable if the same is of no further use to the department. The formal administrative inspection and declaration of an item as unfit for continued service due to fair wear and tear or technical obsolescence is termed 'Condemnation'. Condemnation by a competent authority or Condemnation Committee is a mandatory prerequisite before any government property can be legally written off from stock records and sold, scrapped, or disposed of.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के अध्याय 7 (वस्तुओं का निपटान) के नियम 217 के अंतर्गत, जब कोई वस्तु सामान्य टूट-फूट, क्षति या तकनीकी अप्रचलन के कारण विभाग के लिए उपयोगी नहीं रह जाती है, तो उसे अनुपयोगी, अधिशेष या अप्रचलित घोषित करने की औपचारिक प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया 'कंडमनेशन' (Condemnation / अनुपयोगी घोषित करना) कहलाती है। कंडमनेशन समिति की संस्तुति और सक्षम प्राधिकारी के अनुमोदन के बाद ही किसी सरकारी सामग्री को स्टॉक रजिस्टर से अपलेखित (write-off) करने और सार्वजनिक निपटान/नीलामी की प्रक्रिया शुरू की जा सकती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Condemnation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Rule 217 of the General Financial Rules 2017, condemnation is the formal administrative process of inspecting and declaring an asset unserviceable due to normal operational wear and tear, physical damage, or technical obsolescence. Declaring an item condemned is a mandatory prerequisite before striking it off registers and initiating disposal.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements best describes the primary scope and applicability of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: They apply exclusively to central public sector enterprises and statutory corporations.
They serve purely as non-binding advisory guidelines for state government expenditures.
They regulate the monetary policy operations of the Reserve Bank of India.
They apply to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, including their attached and subordinate offices.
questions.explanation_english: According to Rule 1 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, these rules constitute a comprehensive compendium of executive orders and administrative instructions issued by the Ministry of Finance (Department of Expenditure). They apply to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, as well as their attached and subordinate offices, and to autonomous bodies except to the extent that separate financial rules have been framed by them and approved by the Government. GFR sets standard procedures for public financial management, procurement of goods and services, budgeting, grants-in-aid, and contract management across the Central Government framework.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 1 के अनुसार, ये नियम वित्त मंत्रालय (व्यय विभाग) द्वारा जारी कार्यकारी आदेशों और प्रशासनिक निर्देशों का एक व्यापक संग्रह हैं। ये नियम भारत सरकार के सभी मंत्रालयों, विभागों तथा उनके संलग्न (attached) और अधीनस्थ (subordinate) कार्यालयों पर अनिवार्य रूप से लागू होते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त, ये स्वायत्त निकायों पर भी लागू होते हैं, जब तक कि उनके स्वयं के वित्तीय नियम सरकार द्वारा अनुमोदित न किए गए हों। राज्य सरकारें अपने स्वयं के वित्तीय नियमों से संचालित होती हैं, अतः GFR प्रत्यक्षतः उन पर बाध्यकारी नहीं हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) They are applicable to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India and its attached and subordinate offices.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Departments of the Government of India and its attached and subordinate offices. The General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 are a comprehensive set of administrative instructions issued by the Ministry of Finance to govern public finances. These rules apply universally to all Central Government Ministries, Departments, and their subordinate or attached offices. Unless specific exemptions are sanctioned, every administrative unit under the executive framework must strictly adhere to these prescribed standards.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements correctly describes the "Two-Bid System" (simultaneous receipt of technical and financial bids) under Rule 163 of GFR 2017?
options_english: Technical bids and financial bids are submitted simultaneously in two separate sealed covers, with the financial bids opened only for technically qualified bidders.
Bids are invited exclusively from two pre-selected and pre-registered commercial vendors on a rotation basis.
A single bidder is required to submit the exact same bid document twice—first physically and subsequently via an online portal.
Two distinct government departments participate as competing buyers bidding against one another in an open market auction.
questions.explanation_english: Rule 163 of GFR 2017 outlines the 'Two-Bid System' (simultaneous receipt of technical and financial bids). For purchasing high-value plant, machinery, specialized IT equipment, or complex goods, bids are invited in two separate sealed envelopes: one containing the 'Technical Bid' (commercial terms, technical compliance, certifications, client references) and the other containing the 'Financial Bid' (price schedule). Initially, only the technical bids are opened and evaluated against pre-disclosed criteria. The financial bids of only those bidders who are found technically responsive and qualified are opened on a notified date in the presence of bidders. Financial bids of disqualified bidders are returned unopened. This safeguards against lower-quality goods being selected merely due to artificially low pricing.
questions.explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 163 में 'द्वि-बोली प्रणाली' (Two-Bid System) का उल्लेख है। उच्च मूल्य की मशीनरी, वैज्ञानिक उपकरणों या जटिल तकनीकी वस्तुओं की खरीद हेतु बोलीदाताओं से दो अलग-अलग सीलबंद लिफाफों में एक साथ बोलियां मांगी जाती हैं—एक लिफाफे में 'तकनीकी बोली' (तकनीकी विनिर्देश, योग्यता प्रमाण पत्र, आदि) और दूसरे में 'वित्तीय बोली' (दरें/मूल्य)। प्रथम चरण में केवल तकनीकी बोलियां खोली और जांची जाती हैं। केवल उन्हीं बोलीदाताओं की वित्तीय बोलियां खोली जाती हैं जो तकनीकी मूल्यांकन में योग्य (technically qualified) पाए जाते हैं। अयोग्य बोलीदाताओं की वित्तीय बोलियां बिना खोले वापस कर दी जाती हैं, जिससे केवल कम कीमत के आधार पर घटिया गुणवत्ता वाली वस्तुओं के चयन का जोखिम समाप्त हो जाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Technical and financial bids are submitted simultaneously in two separate sealed envelopes.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: simultaneously in two separate sealed envelopes. Under Rule 163, the two-bid system requires bidders to submit their technical qualifications and commercial prices simultaneously in two separate, sealed envelopes. The procuring authority opens and evaluates the technical proposals first. Financial bids are subsequently opened only for those bidders whose technical offers fully meet the mandatory technical requirements, thereby preventing financial considerations from compromising technical quality standards.

questions.question_english: Under the General Financial Rules (GFR), a "Drawing and Disbursing Officer" (DDO) is primarily entrusted with which of the following core responsibilities?
options_english: Formulating and amending macro financial regulations for the entire Ministry.
Drawing moneys from the Government Account through the treasury or Pay and Accounts Office and disbursing them to authorized payees.
Conducting external statutory financial audits of subordinate departments.
Formulating fiscal and monetary policy frameworks for central regulatory bodies.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017 and Central Treasury Rules / Receipt and Payment Rules, a 'Drawing and Disbursing Officer' (DDO) is a Gazetted Officer authorized to draw bills and money from the Government Account (via the Pay and Accounts Office or Treasury) and disburse payments to staff, vendors, contractors, and beneficiaries. The DDO is responsible for verifying the correctness of bills, maintaining the Government Cash Book, ensuring timely physical verification of cash, deduction of statutory taxes (TDS), and rendering accounted vouchers to the accounting authority.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements correctly identifies the statutory scope and regulatory limitations of an office Permanent Advance (Imprest)?
options_english: It can be freely utilized by the Head of Office to disburse regular monthly salaries and wages of Group 'D' casual staff.
It is strictly intended for meeting petty contingent charges that require immediate settlement before regular funds can be drawn from the accounts office.
It can be validly utilized to grant temporary cash advances to subordinate staff members for urgent personal medical needs.
The total imprest amount can be indefinitely enhanced by the Head of Office at their own administrative discretion.
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 322 of GFR 2017:
1. Statutory Purpose: An office permanent advance is strictly and exclusively intended for meeting petty contingent charges that require immediate settlement before funds can be obtained on a regular contingent bill from the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO).
2. Prohibited Uses: Imprest funds can NEVER be utilized for:
   - Paying regular monthly salaries, wages, or honoraria to permanent or casual staff.
   - Extending personal loans, temporary borrowings, or financial assistance to employees, peons, or officers under any circumstances.
   - Circumventing standard public procurement procedures or making split purchases to evade tender limits.
3. Sanctioning Limit: A Head of Office cannot enhance the imprest amount unilaterally; only the Head of Department (HoD) or designated Competent Authority under DFPR can revise or enhance the sanctioned imprest limit after evaluating administrative necessity.
Therefore, Option B is the correct statement.
questions.explanation_hindi:
जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 322 के तहत:
1. वैधानिक उद्देश्य: कार्यालय स्थायी अग्रिम का उद्देश्य केवल और केवल उन छोटे आकस्मिक व्ययों (Petty Contingent Charges) को पूरा करना है जिनका भुगतान वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) से नियमित आकस्मिक बिल पर धन प्राप्त होने की प्रतीक्षा किए बिना तत्काल किया जाना अनिवार्य होता है।
2. प्रतिबंधित उपयोग: इम्प्रेस्ट निधि का उपयोग निम्नलिखित कार्यों के लिए कभी नहीं किया जा सकता:
   - नियमित या आकस्मिक कर्मचारियों के मासिक वेतन, मजदूरी या मानदेय का भुगतान करना।
   - किसी भी परिस्थिति में कर्मचारियों, चपरासियों या अधिकारियों को व्यक्तिगत ऋण, अस्थायी उधार या वित्तीय सहायता देना।
   - मानक सार्वजनिक खरीद प्रक्रियाओं को दरकिनार करना या निविदा सीमाओं से बचने के लिए खरीद को टुकड़ों में विभाजित करना।
3. सीमा निर्धारण: कार्यालय प्रमुख एकतरफा रूप से इम्प्रेस्ट की राशि में वृद्धि नहीं कर सकता; केवल डीएफपीआर (DFPR) के तहत सक्षम प्राधिकारी/विभागाध्यक्ष ही प्रशासनिक आवश्यकता के मूल्यांकन के बाद स्वीकृत सीमा को बढ़ा सकते हैं।
अतः विकल्प B सही कथन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) It is strictly intended for petty contingent charges requiring payment before drawing funds from PAO.

An office permanent advance is strictly intended for paying petty contingent charges that require immediate settlement before regular funds can be drawn from the accounts office. Imprest cash cannot be utilized for disbursing regular staff salaries, personal staff loans, or unauthorized personal advances, nor can its limit be enhanced without higher competent authority sanction.

questions.question_english: Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR) and General Financial Rules (GFR), who is empowered to sanction a Permanent Advance (Imprest) for a subordinate office or school?
options_english: The Senior Cashier or Accounts Assistant maintaining the cash book of the subordinate office.
The Senior Branch Manager of the local public sector bank handling the departmental account.
The Chief Minister of the State acting through the Department of Finance cabinet committee.
The Head of Department (HoD) / Competent Authority as designated under DFPR.
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 322 of GFR 2017 read in conjunction with Schedule V of the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR):
1. Sanctioning Authority: The Head of Department (HoD) or an authority specifically designated as a Competent Authority under DFPR possesses the statutory power to create and sanction a permanent advance (imprest) for subordinate offices and institutions under their administrative control.
2. Assessment Criteria: The sanctioning authority fixes the quantum of the permanent advance based on a careful assessment of the minimum essential petty cash requirements necessary for efficient day-to-day office operations, in consultation with the accredited financial adviser / accounts authority.
3. Institutional Custodians: Subordinate office cashiers, bank branch managers, or political executives outside the statutory financial delegation hierarchy have no legal authority to determine or sanction government imprest advances.
Therefore, the Head of Department / Competent Authority as per DFPR holds the authority.

जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 322 तथा वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियमों (DFPR) की अनुसूची V के अनुसार:
1. स्वीकृति प्राधिकारी: विभागाध्यक्ष (Head of Department - HoD) अथवा DFPR के तहत विशेष रूप से नामित सक्षम प्राधिकारी को अपने प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण के अधीन आने वाले अधीनस्थ कार्यालयों और संस्थानों के लिए स्थायी अग्रिम (इम्प्रेस्ट) सृजित और स्वीकृत करने का वैधानिक अधिकार प्राप्त है।
2. मूल्यांकन के मानदंड: सक्षम प्राधिकारी मान्यता प्राप्त वित्तीय सलाहकार/लेखा प्राधिकारी के परामर्श से कार्यालय के कुशल दैनिक संचालन के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम खुदरा नकद आवश्यकताओं के सावधानीपूर्वक मूल्यांकन के आधार पर स्थायी अग्रिम की सीमा तय करता है।
3. संस्थागत सीमाएं: अधीनस्थ कार्यालय के कैशियर, बैंक शाखा प्रबंधक या वित्तीय प्रत्यायोजन पदानुक्रम से बाहर के राजनीतिक पदाधिकारियों को सरकारी इम्प्रेस्ट अग्रिम निर्धारित करने या स्वीकृत करने का कोई कानूनी अधिकार नहीं है।
अतः सही उत्तर डीएफपीआर के तहत विभागाध्यक्ष / सक्षम प्राधिकारी है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The Head of Department / Competent Authority as per DFPR.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Authority as per DFPR. Sanctioning a permanent advance for an establishment falls under the administrative authority of the Head of Department or designated competent authority under Delegation of Financial Powers Rules. The sanctioning authority fixes the imprest limit after assessing the minimum essential petty cash requirements necessary for efficient day-to-day office operations.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Complete physical verification of library books in large public/educational institutions is conducted periodically in cycles rather than annually if the library possesses a large volume of books (e.g., exceeding 50,000 volumes).
Reason (R): GFR 2017 prescribes tiered verification frequencies linked to the total holding size of the library to ensure operational feasibility without disrupting day-to-day library operations.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 215 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, physical verification of library books is governed by volume-based statutory schedules:
1. Libraries with not more than 20,000 volumes: complete physical verification must be undertaken at least once a year.
2. Libraries with more than 20,000 and up to 50,000 volumes: physical verification should be done at least once in three years.
3. Libraries having more than 50,000 volumes: physical verification should be carried out at least once in three years, or sample verification of not less than 10% of volumes may be conducted annually so that the entire library is covered within five years.
Thus, Assertion (A) is completely true, Reason (R) accurately captures the rationale behind tiered frequencies under GFR Rule 215, and Reason (R) is the direct and correct explanation of Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 215 के तहत पुस्तकालय की पुस्तकों के भौतिक सत्यापन हेतु पुस्तकों की संख्या के आधार पर व्यावहारिक व्यवस्था दी गई है:
1. 20,000 तक पुस्तकों वाले पुस्तकालय: प्रतिवर्ष कम से कम एक बार पूर्ण भौतिक सत्यापन।
2. 20,000 से अधिक और 50,000 तक पुस्तकों वाले पुस्तकालय: तीन वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार सत्यापन।
3. 50,000 से अधिक पुस्तकों वाले बड़े पुस्तकालय: तीन वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार, अथवा प्रतिवर्ष कम से कम 10% पुस्तकों का नमूना (सैंपल) सत्यापन जिससे 5 वर्षों में संपूर्ण पुस्तकालय कवर हो जाए।
अतः बड़े पुस्तकालयों में दैनिक पठन-पाठन और परिचालन बाधित न हो, इसके लिए वार्षिक के बजाय आवधिक/चक्रीय सत्यापन का नियम बनाया गया है। इसलिए (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) For institutional libraries containing large holdings above fifty thousand volumes, annual complete physical verification becomes operationally impractical. Consequently, financial rules prescribe sample physical checks or staggered multi-year verification cycles based on total holdings, establishing practical sample sizes and intervals to ensure inventory oversight without disrupting library services.

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Internal audit acts as a continuous and preliminary check on departmental financial transactions before the external statutory audit.
Reason (R): The internal audit wing operates under the administrative control of the Chief Controller of Accounts (CCA) / Principal Accounts Office of the respective Ministry or Department.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are factually true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
- Assertion (A) is true: Internal audit is designed functionally as a continuous, in-house appraisal mechanism to scrutinize financial transactions, detect procedural errors, ensure compliance with GFR, and rectify control deficiencies before the external statutory audit by the CAG takes place.
- Reason (R) is true: Under the departmentalized accounting system of the Government of India, the internal audit wing functions under the administrative and technical superintendence of the Chief Controller of Accounts (CCA) or Controller of Accounts in each Ministry.
- However, (R) does not explain the functional reason why internal audit acts as a preliminary check. Internal audit acts as a preliminary check because of its inherent managerial objective to protect institutional assets, enhance compliance, and assist the executive leadership, not merely because of its administrative reporting hierarchy under the CCA. Therefore, Option B is the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों तथ्यतः सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
- अभिकथन (A) सही है: आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा का मूल उद्देश्य वित्तीय लेन-देन की निरंतर आंतरिक जाँच करना, जीएफआर के नियमों का अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करना और सीएजी द्वारा की जाने वाली बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा से पहले त्रुटियों को सुधारना है ताकि विभाग की वित्तीय प्रणाली त्रुटिहीन रहे।
- कारण (R) सही है: भारत सरकार की विभागीय लेखा प्रणाली के तहत, आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा विंग वास्तव में संबंधित मंत्रालय के मुख्य लेखा नियंत्रक (CCA) या प्रधान लेखा कार्यालय के प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण में कार्य करता है।
- यद्यपि दोनों कथन सत्य हैं, परंतु (R) इस बात की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता कि आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा प्रारंभिक जाँच के रूप में क्यों कार्य करती है। प्रारंभिक जाँच इसका आंतरिक प्रबंधकीय उद्देश्य है, जो इसकी प्रशासनिक संरचना (CCA के अधीन होना) का प्रत्यक्ष परिणाम नहीं है। अतः विकल्प B सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Internal audit provides preliminary, continuous oversight of departmental financial transactions prior to external statutory audits. Operating under the administrative control of the departmental Chief Controller of Accounts ensures organizational structure, but the core reason internal audit functions as an early check is to rectify internal control deficiencies before final statutory audits.

questions.question_english: A Head of School urgently needs to purchase 50 computer sets for establishing a new IT lab. To avoid obtaining administrative approval from the higher authority and to bypass the formal competitive tendering process, the Head splits the purchase into five separate orders of 10 computers each over a span of two weeks. Under GFR 2017, this administrative action is:
options_english: Prohibited, as splitting demand to avoid obtaining the sanction of a higher authority or competitive bidding is strictly restricted.
Permissible under administrative emergency powers to expedite student digital learning.
Recommended by financial guidelines to maintain operational liquidity in school accounts.
Permissible provided the total expenditure is subsequently ratified by the School Management Committee (SMC).
questions.explanation_english:
Splitting of procurement requirements is strictly illegal under the General Financial Rules.

Statutory Rule:
Rule 157 of GFR 2017 states: "A demand for goods should not be divided into smaller quantities for making piecemeal purchases for the purpose of avoiding the necessity of obtaining the sanction of higher authority required with reference to the estimated value of the total demand."

Consequences and Implications:
1. Demand aggregation: Public buying principles mandate assessing and aggregating the full foreseeable requirement over a reasonable period (such as an academic session or financial year).
2. Violation: Artificially breaking up a bulk purchase into small batches (piecemeal purchasing) to fit within petty purchase limits (Rule 154 or Rule 155) or to bypass GeM bidding thresholds is a serious financial irregularity inviting disciplinary action against the DDO.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों के तहत खरीद आवश्यकताओं को कृत्रिम रूप से विभाजित करना पूरी तरह से अवैध है।

वैधानिक नियम:
GFR 2017 का नियम 157 स्पष्ट रूप से कहता है: "कुल मांग के अनुमानित मूल्य के संदर्भ में आवश्यक उच्च प्राधिकारी की स्वीकृति प्राप्त करने की आवश्यकता से बचने के उद्देश्य से वस्तुओं की मांग को टुकड़ों में खरीद करने के लिए छोटी मात्रा में विभाजित नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।"

परिणाम और निहितार्थ:
1. मांग का समूहन (Demand Aggregation): सार्वजनिक खरीद नियमों के अनुसार एक उचित अवधि (जैसे एक शैक्षणिक सत्र या वित्तीय वर्ष) के लिए संपूर्ण आवश्यकता का आकलन और समूहन किया जाना चाहिए।
2. उल्लंघन: एकमुश्त खरीद को छोटी-छोटी श्रेणियों में विभाजित करना ताकि वे नियम 154 या 155 (बिना निविदा खरीद) की सीमाओं में आ सकें या GeM बोली से बचा जा सके, एक गंभीर वित्तीय अनियमितता है जिसके लिए DDO अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई का भागीदार बनता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Prohibited, as splitting demand to avoid obtaining sanction of higher authority is restricted.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: obtaining sanction of higher authority is restricted. Dividing a single total requirement into multiple smaller purchase orders to circumvent the monetary limits requiring higher administrative approval or formal competitive tendering is strictly prohibited under financial rules. Demand splitting undermines centralized procurement oversight and violates transparency principles. Procuring authorities must consolidate requirements over a reasonable timeframe to ensure open competitive pricing and appropriate administrative approval levels.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Imprest (Permanent Advance) System:
I. The quantum of permanent advance is fixed by the competent authority based on the routine petty cash requirements of the office.
II. The imprest cash should be kept strictly separate and not mixed up with any other government or private cash held by the officer.
III. The imprest cannot be recouped during the year and must last for the entire financial year without replenishment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 322 of GFR 2017 and Government Accounting Rules:
- Statement I is correct: The amount of the permanent advance is fixed by the Head of Department or designated competent authority based on a realistic assessment of the minimum essential petty cash requirements necessary for efficient day-to-day office operations, normally not exceeding the monthly petty expenditure.
- Statement II is correct: Under Receipt and Payment Rules, imprest cash is a distinct custody fund and must never be commingled with regular government revenues, departmental chest receipts, undisbursed pay and allowances, or personal private cash. It must be accounted for independently in a dedicated Imprest Cash Register.
- Statement III is incorrect: The defining operational characteristic of the imprest system is periodic recoupment. Whenever the petty cash balance is depleted (or at regular monthly/fortnightly intervals), the holding officer submits an imprest recoupment bill accompanied by paid sub-vouchers to the accounts office. Upon audit and payment, the exact expended amount is reimbursed, constantly restoring the cash balance to its original sanctioned limit. It does not have to last the entire year without replenishment.
Therefore, Statements I and II only are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 322 और सरकारी लेखा नियमों के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: स्थायी अग्रिम की राशि विभागाध्यक्ष या नामित सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा कार्यालय के दैनिक कार्यों के कुशल संचालन हेतु आवश्यक न्यूनतम खुदरा नकद आवश्यकताओं के वास्तविक आकलन के आधार पर तय की जाती है, जो सामान्यतः एक महीने के खुदरा खर्च से अधिक नहीं होती।
- कथन II सही है: प्राप्ति और भुगतान नियमों के तहत, इम्प्रेस्ट नकदी एक विशिष्ट अभिरक्षा निधि है और इसे नियमित सरकारी राजस्व, विभागीय चेस्ट प्राप्तियों, अवितरित वेतन और भत्तों, या व्यक्तिगत नकदी के साथ कभी नहीं मिलाया जाना चाहिए। इसका हिसाब एक समर्पित 'इम्प्रेस्ट रोकड़ बही' (Imprest Cash Book) में स्वतंत्र रूप से रखा जाना अनिवार्य है।
- कथन III गलत है: इम्प्रेस्ट प्रणाली की सबसे प्रमुख विशेषता इसकी समय-समय पर प्रतिपूर्ति (Recoupment) है। जैसे ही खुदरा नकदी कम होती है (या नियमित मासिक/पाक्षिक अंतराल पर), प्रभारी अधिकारी भुगतान किए गए उप-वाउचरों के साथ एक प्रतिपूर्ति बिल लेखा कार्यालय को प्रस्तुत करता है। सत्यापन और भुगतान के पश्चात खर्च की गई सटीक राशि वापस मिल जाती है, जिससे नकद शेष निरंतर अपनी मूल स्वीकृत सीमा पर बना रहता है। ऐसा नहीं है कि इसे बिना प्रतिपूर्ति के पूरे साल चलाना पड़े।
अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

questions.question_english: What is the primary purpose and scope of the Internal Audit mechanism established within government departments under GFR 2017?

questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 65 to Rule 68 of GFR 2017, Internal Audit is an independent, objective assurance and consulting activity designed to add value and improve an organization's operations. Functioning under the Chief Controller of Accounts / Financial Adviser, the internal audit wing assists the administrative management in accomplishing its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, internal controls, governance processes, and compliance with statutory financial rules. It helps identify system weaknesses, billing errors, and procedural non-compliance proactively before external statutory audit by the CAG.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 65 से 68 के तहत, आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा (Internal Audit) एक स्वतंत्र, वस्तुनिष्ठ आश्वासन और परामर्शीय गतिविधि है जिसे संगठन के कार्यों में मूल्य संवर्धन और सुधार करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। मुख्य लेखा नियंत्रक (CCA) और वित्तीय सलाहकार के अधीन कार्य करते हुए आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा विंग जोखिम प्रबंधन, आंतरिक वित्तीय नियंत्रण, सुशासन प्रक्रियाओं और वित्तीय नियमों के अनुपालन की प्रभावशीलता का व्यवस्थित मूल्यांकन करता है। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य सीएजी (CAG) द्वारा की जाने वाली बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा से पहले प्रणालीगत कमियों और प्रक्रियात्मक त्रुटियों की पहचान कर उन्हें समय पर सुधारना है।

questions.question_hindi: सप्ताहांत के दौरान विद्यालय की विज्ञान प्रयोगशाला में चोरी हो जाती है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप ₹60,000 मूल्य के सूक्ष्मदर्शी (microscopes) चोरी हो जाते हैं। जीएफआर (GFR) 2017 के अनुसार, प्रधानाचार्य को तत्काल कौन-से प्रशासनिक एवं विधिक कदम उठाने चाहिए?
options_hindi: विद्यालय की बदनामी से बचने के लिए शिक्षक-अभिभावक संघ (PTA) के फंड का उपयोग करके बिना किसी को बताए सूक्ष्मदर्शी बदल देना।

स्थानीय पुलिस में प्राथमिकी (FIR) दर्ज कराना और अगले उच्च प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी, सांविधिक लेखापरीक्षा तथा लेखा अधिकारी को तत्काल हानि की रिपोर्ट भेजना।
कोई औपचारिक विभागीय जांच किए बिना प्रभारी विज्ञान शिक्षक पर ₹60,000 का आर्थिक दंड लगाना।

questions.question_english: A theft occurs in a school science laboratory over the weekend, resulting in the loss of microscopes worth Rs. 60,000. According to GFR 2017, what immediate legal and administrative steps must the Principal take?
options_english: Quietly replace missing microscopes using Parent-Teacher Association funds to avoid negative publicity for the school.
Directly write off the total financial loss under the Principal's delegated administrative powers without reporting.
File an FIR with police and report the loss to higher authorities, Statutory Audit, and Accounts Officer.
Impose a financial penalty of Rs. 60,000 on the science teacher in charge without conducting a formal inquiry.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 33 and Rule 34 of GFR 2017, whenever public property or stores are stolen, the Head of Office / Principal is legally bound to take immediate concurrent administrative and legal actions: (1) Lodge a formal First Information Report (FIR) with the local police station without delay, as the incident involves a cognizable criminal offense (theft) and exceeds the threshold of Rs. 50,000; (2) Transmit an immediate official preliminary loss report to the next higher administrative authority (such as the Directorate of Education / District Education Office), the Statutory Audit Officer, and the Principal Accounts Officer. Suppressing the crime, utilizing unauthorized funds like PTA to quietly purchase replacements, or writing off stolen government property without police and administrative investigations are grave violations of government conduct and financial rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR) 2017 के नियम 33 और नियम 34 के अनुसार, सरकारी संपत्ति या भंडार की चोरी होने पर कार्यालय प्रमुख/प्रधानाचार्य को तत्काल निम्नलिखित विधिक एवं प्रशासनिक कदम उठाने होते हैं: (1) स्थानीय पुलिस थाने में बिना किसी विलंब के प्राथमिकी (FIR) दर्ज कराना, क्योंकि यह एक संज्ञेय आपराधिक कृत्य (चोरी) है और इसकी राशि ₹50,000 से अधिक है; (2) अपने अगले उच्चतर प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी (जैसे शिक्षा निदेशालय/जिला शिक्षा अधिकारी), सांविधिक लेखापरीक्षा अधिकारी (Statutory Audit Officer) तथा प्रधान लेखा अधिकारी को तत्काल एक प्रारंभिक हानि रिपोर्ट प्रेषित करना। घटना को छिपाना, पीटीए (PTA) फंड का दुरुपयोग कर चुपके से नए उपकरण खरीदना अथवा बिना पुलिस जांच व उच्चाधिकारी की स्वीकृति के इसे बट्टे खाते में डालना वित्तीय नियमों एवं आचरण नियमावली का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (c) File an FIR with police and report the loss to higher authorities and audit.

In the event of theft involving government property, the establishment head must take immediate legal and administrative actions. This requires lodging a formal First Information Report with local police authorities and promptly submitting official loss reports to higher administrative authorities, the statutory audit officer, and the departmental accounts officer.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Government contracts that are not drafted in a standard prescribed form must be legally vetted by the Ministry of Law and Justice prior to formal execution.
Reason (R): Non-standard, customized contractual clauses can expose the government to unforeseen legal liabilities, ambiguous obligations, and substantial financial risks.
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english: Rule 225(ii) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 explicitly lays down that standard forms of contracts should be adopted wherever possible. In cases where standard forms are unavailable or significant departures from standard terms are contemplated, the draft contract must be referred to the Ministry of Law and Justice for legal vetting before execution. The rationale behind this mandatory legal vetting is that customized or non-standard contractual terms frequently contain legal loopholes, ambiguities regarding dispute resolution, indemnity, and termination rights, which could expose the Government to serious litigation, unexpected financial claims, and legal liabilities. Thus, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and Reason (R) provides the accurate legal and financial explanation for Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR), 2017 के नियम 225(ii) में यह स्पष्ट प्रावधान है कि जहाँ तक संभव हो, सरकारी विभागों को अनुबंध के मानक प्रपत्रों का ही उपयोग करना चाहिए। यदि मानक प्रपत्र उपलब्ध न हों अथवा मानक शर्तों से कोई महत्वपूर्ण विचलन आवश्यक हो, तो अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर करने से पूर्व विधि एवं न्याय मंत्रालय (Ministry of Law and Justice) द्वारा उसका कानूनी परीक्षण (Legal Vetting) कराया जाना अनिवार्य है। इसका मुख्य कारण यह है कि गैर-मानक अथवा स्वनिर्मित अनुबंधात्मक धाराओं में अक्सर अस्पष्टताएं, कानूनी कमियां या मध्यस्थता संबंधी जटिलताएं हो सकती हैं, जो सरकार को अप्रत्याशित वित्तीय देनदारियों, नुकसान और अदालती मुकदमों के गंभीर जोखिम में डाल सकती हैं। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है। सही विकल्प A है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Mandatory legal vetting ensures that non-standard clauses are legally sound, adequately protect government interests, prevent ambiguous liabilities, and mitigate potential legal or financial risks during contract performance.

questions.question_hindi: प्रधान लेखा कार्यालय (Principal Accounts Office) से एक आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा दल विद्यालय के खातों के निरीक्षण हेतु आता है। दल पिछले तीन वित्तीय वर्षों के मध्याह्न भोजन योजना (पीएम पोषण / PM POSHAN) के रोकड़ बही (कैश बुक), सहायक रजिस्टरों और व्यय वाउचरों की जाँच करने की मांग करता है। इस स्थिति में विद्यालय प्राचार्य का क्या कर्तव्य है?
options_hindi: मांगे गए सभी खाता-बही, रजिस्टर और वाउचर तुरंत उपलब्ध कराने चाहिए, क्योंकि आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा को सभी सरकारी वित्तीय लेन-देन की जाँच करने का विधिक अधिदेश प्राप्त है।
पीएम पोषण अभिलेखों के निरीक्षण से यह कहते हुए इनकार कर देना चाहिए कि मध्याह्न भोजन निधि केंद्रीय योजना अनुदान है जो विभागीय आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा के क्षेत्राधिकार से बाहर है।

केवल वर्तमान चालू वित्तीय वर्ष से संबंधित अभिलेख और वाउचर ही प्रस्तुत करने चाहिए।

questions.question_english: An Internal Audit team from the Principal Accounts Office arrives at a government school to inspect the accounts. The audit team demands to examine the mid-day meal scheme (PM POSHAN) cash book, subsidiary registers, and expenditure vouchers for the past three financial years. What is the duty of the school Principal in this situation?
options_english: Provide all requested books of accounts, registers, and vouchers promptly, as internal audit has the legal mandate to examine all government financial transactions.
Refuse inspection of PM POSHAN records, claiming that mid-day meal funds are central scheme grants beyond the jurisdiction of departmental internal audit.
Instruct the audit party to return only after the external statutory audit by the CAG has been concluded.
Produce only the records and vouchers corresponding strictly to the current ongoing financial year.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 67 of GFR 2017 and standard Treasury / Receipt and Payment Rules, an internal audit party deputed by the Principal Accounts Office / Controller of Accounts possesses full authority to inspect all books of accounts, registers, subsidiary cash books, expenditure vouchers, bank statements, and stock registers maintained by any Head of Office (HoO) / Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO). questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Advance:
I. The advance is limited to up to 90% of the estimated permissible journey fare.
II. The advance can generally be drawn up to 65 days before the proposed date of outward journey for rail travel.
III. If the ticket is not purchased within the specified time after drawing the advance, the advance must be refunded immediately in full.
IV. LTC advance can be utilized to pay for boarding and lodging during the trip.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I, II and III only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
questions.explanation_english:
Under Central Civil Services (Leave Travel Concession) Rules, 1988:
- Statement I is correct: An advance up to 90% of the estimated permissible travel fare may be sanctioned to a government servant for both outward and return journeys.
- Statement II is correct: In case of rail travel, commensurate with the Advance Reservation Period (ARP) of Indian Railways, the advance can be drawn up to 65 days before the proposed date of the outward journey.
- Statement III is correct: The advance must be utilized for the purchase of tickets within the stipulated period (ordinarily within 10 days of drawal). If tickets are not purchased or produced within this timeframe, the entire advance must be refunded immediately in full into the government account.
- Statement IV is incorrect: LTC rules exclusively cover journey transportation fares (rail, authorized air fare, or approved public bus service as per entitlement). Charges for boarding, lodging, hotel stay, tour guides, and local sight-seeing cannot be claimed or paid from the LTC advance.
Therefore, Statements I, II, and III are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश यात्रा रियायत) नियमावली, 1988 के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: सरकारी सेवक को स्वयं तथा उसके परिवार के पात्र सदस्यों के लिए अनुमानित स्वीकार्य यात्रा किराए का 90% तक अग्रिम स्वीकृत किया जा सकता है।
- कथन II सही है: रेल यात्रा के मामले में, भारतीय रेलवे की अग्रिम आरक्षण अवधि (ARP) के अनुरूप, यात्रा शुरू होने की प्रस्तावित तिथि से 65 दिन पूर्व तक अग्रिम आहरित किया जा सकता है।
- कथन III सही है: अग्रिम प्राप्त करने के बाद यदि निर्धारित समय (सामान्यतः 10 दिन) के भीतर टिकट नहीं खरीदा जाता है, तो अग्रिम की संपूर्ण राशि तुरंत एकमुश्त सरकारी खाते में वापस जमा करनी होती है।
- कथन IV गलत है: एलटीसी अग्रिम केवल यात्रा के परिवहन किराए (पात्रता अनुसार रेल, अधिकृत हवाई यात्रा या अनुमोदित बस किराया) के लिए ही सीमित है। यात्रा के दौरान भोजन (खान-पान), होटल में ठहरने और स्थानीय भ्रमण के खर्चों को एलटीसी अग्रिम से पूरा नहीं किया जा सकता।
अतः कथन I, II और III सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Leave Travel Concession advance is limited to a specified percentage of estimated travel fares and can be drawn up to sixty-five days prior to rail journey departures. Unused advances must be refunded immediately if tickets are not purchased promptly. However, LTC advance is strictly restricted to transportation fares and cannot cover lodging or boarding expenses.
